title: ChargeFW calculation result JSON 1.0
description: A complete machine-readable record of one ChargeFW calculation invocation. Charge arrays use calculation atom order; structural charge-to-site correspondence is provided by generated mmCIF.

schema_version.description: Version of the ChargeFW calculation result format.

diagnostics.description: Invocation-level diagnostics, including issues that are not specific to one input record.

results.description: Per-record outcomes in input order. record_index identifies each input record within its source.

oneOf.title: Success
oneOf.description: Calculation completed and charge assignments are available.

oneOf.title: Invalid input or request
oneOf.description: The molecular input or calculation request failed validation.

oneOf.title: No executable plan
oneOf.description: No scientifically applicable and executable method plan was available.

oneOf.title: Numerical failure
oneOf.description: The selected calculation failed during numerical execution.

oneOf.title: Cancelled
oneOf.description: The calculation was cooperatively cancelled.

portableId.description: A caller-supplied identifier represented as a string or signed 64-bit integer.

assignments.description: Charge assignments for this record. Each charges array follows calculation atom order.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics associated with this input record.

record_index.description: Zero-based record position within the source.

atom_ids.description: Caller-supplied atom IDs in calculation atom order.

oneOf.title: ChargeFW molecule JSON
oneOf.description: ChargeFW's versioned molecule interchange format.

oneOf.title: MOL
oneOf.description: A single MDL MOL record.

oneOf.title: SDF
oneOf.description: An MDL structure-data file record.

oneOf.title: MOL2
oneOf.description: A Tripos MOL2 molecule record.

oneOf.title: PDB
oneOf.description: A Protein Data Bank coordinate entry.

oneOf.title: PDBx/mmCIF
oneOf.description: A coordinate-bearing mmCIF data block.

format.description: Format used to import this record.

policy.description: Record-specific import choices applied to this structural or molecular input.

oneOf.title: All records
oneOf.description: Retain polymers, ligands, and water residues.

oneOf.title: Polymers and ligands
oneOf.description: Retain polymer and ligand residues while excluding recognized water residues.

oneOf.title: Polymers
oneOf.description: Retain residues classified as linear polymers.

alternate_location_selection.title: First alternate location in source order
alternate_location_selection.description: For each atom name within each residue, select its first source-order alternate location.

oneOf.title: First conformer
oneOf.description: Retain only the first input conformer or structural model.

oneOf.title: All conformers
oneOf.description: Retain all input conformers or structural models in source order.

oneOf.title: No bonds
oneOf.description: Import atoms and coordinates without molecular bonds.

oneOf.title: Explicit bonds
oneOf.description: Use explicit bonds and connections represented by the source format.

oneOf.title: Templates
oneOf.description: Assign connectivity from ChargeFW's built-in residue templates and polymer links.

oneOf.title: Hybrid
oneOf.description: Combine explicit connectivity with built-in templates, preferring explicit connections.

oneOf.title: Connectivity from another source
oneOf.description: The source record supplies no bond data; choose a bond strategy to derive connectivity when needed.

oneOf.title: Explicitly empty connectivity
oneOf.description: The source supplies a connectivity section containing no bonds.

oneOf.title: Connectivity present
oneOf.description: The source supplies one or more bonds.

source_connectivity.description: Connectivity state of the imported source record.

oneOf.title: Molecule-scoped
oneOf.description: One charge vector applies to the molecule and is associated with each of its conformers in molecular output.

oneOf.title: Conformer-scoped
oneOf.description: The charge vector applies only to the conformer identified by target.conformer_index.

charges.description: Full-precision partial charges in electron units, aligned by index with the molecule's atom order. Use each generated mmCIF charge row and its atom_id to resolve a charge to an output structural site.

total_charge.description: Sum of this assignment's partial charges in electron units.

molecule_index.description: Zero-based molecule position in the calculation collection.

conformer_index.description: Zero-based conformer position for a conformer-scoped assignment.

oneOf.title: Information
oneOf.description: An informational event, such as cooperative cancellation.

oneOf.title: Warning
oneOf.description: A non-fatal condition or policy warning.

oneOf.title: Error
oneOf.description: A condition that prevented a successful calculation or record operation.

oneOf.title: Automatic
oneOf.description: Let assessment choose an applicable execution mode according to method capabilities and resource policy.

oneOf.title: Full
oneOf.description: Request a complete calculation for the molecular target.

oneOf.title: Cutoff
oneOf.description: Request radius-fragment calculations centered on source atoms.

oneOf.title: Cover
oneOf.description: Request radius-fragment calculations around pivots, retaining charges in covered interiors.

oneOf.title: No explicit radius
oneOf.description: The request does not specify a radius.

oneOf.title: Full
oneOf.description: The complete molecular target was calculated.

oneOf.title: Cutoff
oneOf.description: Radius-fragment calculations centered on source atoms were used.

oneOf.title: Cover
oneOf.description: Radius-fragment calculations around pivots retained charges in covered interiors.

oneOf.title: No effective radius
oneOf.description: The effective execution mode uses no spatial radius.

fixedChargeGroups.description: Optional effective provenance for fixed charges and per-original-molecule charge budgets.

sources.description: Fixed charges indexed in the original input molecule collection.

charge_totals.description: Original and active charge totals, ordered by original input molecule.

components.description: Optional summaries grouped from imported structural residue labels; these do not imply CCD assignment.

component_id.description: Imported label residue ID, falling back to author residue ID.

charge_per_instance.description: Prescribed charge for each listed monatomic source instance.

molecule_index.description: Zero-based molecule index in the original input collection.

items.description: Zero-based atom index in the original input molecule.

molecule_index.description: Zero-based molecule index in the original input collection.

atom_index.description: Zero-based atom index in the original input molecule.

charge.description: Prescribed source charge in elementary-charge units.

molecule_index.description: Zero-based molecule index in the original input collection.

original_total_charge.description: Supplied original formal-charge total retained for audit provenance.

active_total_charge.description: Formal-charge sum of unselected active atoms in the prepared molecule. The modeled total is this value plus prescribed source charges.

threshold.description: An atom-count threshold or an unlimited threshold.

oneOf.title: Unlimited
oneOf.description: Do not apply an atom-count threshold.

methodOptions.description: Method IDs map to option objects. Option values are scalar strings, numbers, or booleans.
